title: Assistant models
description: The providers the assistant can call and the models on them, with the tags a task asks for and a priority.

providers.description: Where models run. An Ollama endpoint may be on this machine or on another one in the network.

models.description: The models a call can be routed to.

routing.description: How a model that keeps failing is set aside.

failures.description: Consecutive failures after which a model is unavailable. Default 3.

cooldown_seconds.description: How long it stays unavailable. Default 60.

rate_limited_cooldown_seconds.description: How long it stays unavailable after a rate limit (429). Default 30.

type.description: Kind of provider; more arrive as they are built.

project.description: Google Cloud project that bills a vertex provider, e.g. my-project.

location.description: Region of a vertex provider, e.g. us-central1, or global.

base_url.description: Where the provider answers, without credentials, e.g. http://localhost:11434.

id.description: Name of this entry in logs, records and metrics.

provider.description: The id of the provider it runs on.

model.description: The provider's own name for the model, e.g. gemma4:12b.

tags.description: What the model is good for. A task asks for tags; only models that have all of them are candidates.

think.description: Let a thinking-capable model reason first; slow.

first_token_timeout_seconds.description: Wait for the first token, which covers loading the model.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Longest pause between tokens once they flow.

overall_timeout_seconds.description: Longest a whole call may take.

price.description: US dollars per million tokens; both default to 0 (a local model costs nothing).
